brief:
Israeli occupation forces invoke protection of ancient sites as pretext to impose tighter restrictions on Palestinian territories in the West Bank, according to Shehab Wire. The military issues notices classifying expansive land areas as archaeological sites, effectively placing them under heritage protection designation that limits Palestinian access and use.

The practice expands Israeli control over Palestinian land through administrative restrictions framed as preservation measures rather than direct confiscation or settlement expansion.

title: Israel uses archaeology sites as cover for Palestinian land restrictions
